$comment: Upstream linkage for Zeta desktop packages. This file declares the product's own identity and release linkage only. Distro/package-repository package names are owned and normalized by the external package repository (Linxira-OS/packages); do not infer or invent package names from this manifest.

upstreamIdentity.normalizationRule: The external package repository maps upstream release assets onto its own package names. A package name present in that repository is authoritative for install/upgrade; this manifest never claims a distro package name that the repository has not published.

repositories.role: Arch PKGBUILDs; CI builds, signs and publishes pacman repositories

pacmanRepositories.packageFilesRetained: previous package files stay in the rolling release so a version can be reinstalled; stale assets not produced by the current build are dropped

pacmanRepositories.note: Main system repository. Does not contain linxira-zeta (verified from the x86_64 index); the desktop package is only in linxira-zeta.

repositories.role: signed [linxira] pacman repository database + package mirror on GitHub Pages
compiles and publishes the reviewed software catalog database (catalog-v2.json + catalog-v3.json, packaged as linxira-catalog)

packages.name: @linxiraos/zeta
packages.role: coding-agent CLI (the kernel the desktop shell spawns)

packages.name: @linxiraos/main
packages.role: legacy Rust workbench npm launcher; publication only via the manual publish_zetawork gate. Frozen at 1.4.10; it is NOT the desktop product and does not receive 1.5.x.

packages.name: zeta-desktop
packages.role: desktop shell npm identity (desktop/package.json). Private: not published to the npm registry; no npm upgrade path exists for it.

packages.name: linxira-zeta
packages.role: zetawork-era desktop (TUI + GUI) under the same package name; replaced in place by 1.5.x

packages.name: linxira-zetawork
packages.role: legacy standalone workbench binary package (usr/bin/zetawork); replaced and conflicted by current linxira-zeta

packages.name: zeta-desktop
packages.note: electron-builder default package; the 1.4.10 zetawork era shipped no deb, so the first deb installs are already zeta-desktop.

packages.name: linxira-catalog
packages.role: catalog DB package (separate product, listed for repository topology completeness)

packageRepository.note: The rolling repository replaced the 1.5.0 assets with 1.5.1; a 1.5.0-1 package is no longer published, so the 1.5.0->1.5.1 transaction uses a package rebuilt from the published upstream 1.5.0 archive.

migration.policy: Never claim an automatic in-place upgrade where the installer identity or package name differs. Each row below is the authoritative statement for its platform.

zetawork.description: Rust TUI + GUI workbench packaged as linxira-zeta (<= 1.4.10) and as linxira-zetawork (<= 1.4.1)

zetawork-gui.newPackageIdentity: npm zeta-desktop (private) / pacman linxira-zeta / deb zeta-desktop

zetawork-tui.note: the workbench TUI is retired; the CLI is @linxiraos/zeta (bin zetacode)

@linxiraos/main.note: no package rename: @linxiraos/main stays paused at 1.4.10; @linxiraos/zeta is the surviving CLI package (bin zetacode)

rows.procedure: pacman -Syu (with the linxira-zeta section configured) or pacman -U <linxira-zeta-1.5.x pkg>
rows.verificationNote: 2026-11-10: scripts/packaging/verify-linux-upgrade.sh installed the published linxira-zeta-1.4.10-1 into a clean pacman root and upgraded it to the published 1.5.0-1 (sha256 a64fba61...). Version 1.5.0-1, old /usr/bin/zetawork and /usr/lib/zetawork removed, new /opt layout present, bundled kernel reported 1.5.0, ~/.zeta byte-identical. The verify_linux_upgrade CI job repeats it.

rows.procedure: pacman -Syu; pacman honours the target package's Replaces/Conflicts. A bare pacman -U of linxira-zeta does not apply Replaces, so remove linxira-zetawork first in that path.
rows.verificationNote: 2026-11-10: a synthetic linxira-zetawork 1.4.1-1 package was installed, then pacman -Su from a file:// repository holding the published 1.5.0-1 package removed it and installed linxira-zeta through the published Replaces/Conflicts (stub /usr/bin/zetawork removed). The package identity is synthetic because the retired package is no longer published; the target package and its fields are the real published artifact.
Control fields verified for 1.5.0 (Package: zeta-desktop, no Conflicts/Replaces). No deb existed in the 1.4.10 zetawork release, so this row only covers 1.4.12+ installs.

rows.procedure: replace the AppImage file; no package manager state exists
uninstall the zetawork installer, then install zeta-desktop-<version>-win-x64.exe; the two installers do not share an appId or install directory
rows.verificationNote: Old installer identity is the repository's paused NSIS script (Linxira Zeta / HKCU\Software\LinxiraZeta); the new one is electron-builder with appId com.zeta.desktop. No automatic in-place upgrade is claimed.

to.note: the workbench npm surface is not renamed into zeta-desktop; the CLI remains @linxiraos/zeta (bin zetacode)

rows.procedure: npm uninstall -g @linxiraos/main; install the desktop package or @linxiraos/zeta. Do not expect @linxiraos/main to publish 1.5.x.
rows.verificationNote: npm registry shows @linxiraos/main latest 1.4.10 and zeta-desktop absent; desktop/package.json is private.

pacman.note: The 1.5.x package no longer Provides zetawork. Nothing in the repositories depends on that virtual; a third-party package that does will need updating.

configCompatibility.evidence: The zetawork GUI and CLI read ~/.zeta (projects.json, serve.json, agent/web.yml, agent/sessions/, zetawork.toml); the 1.5.x desktop shell discovers the service through ~/.zeta/serve.json and the zeta CLI owns the same root (APP_NAME=zeta). Package payloads never touch $HOME.
notMigrated: Electron shell window/workspace state (app.getPath('userData')/workspace-state.json, desktop-settings.json) has no counterpart in the zetawork GUI and starts fresh.
Old zetawork GUI preferences stored in ~/.zeta/zetawork.toml are left on disk but are not read by the Electron shell.

updateChannel.appUpdateMechanism: release installer/archive replacement; the desktop shell advertises no app-side download (desktop/src/update-check.ts returns plan=none for the app)
updateChannel.runtimeUpdates: owned by the bundled service via GET /api/update/check

distributionChannels.versionFlow: Linxira-OS/linxira-zeta tag v<version> -> upstream-sync opens chore(bump) PR -> packages.yml rebuilds linxira-zeta-<version>-1 -> release asset + index replaced

distributionChannels.note: desktop shell is private and not on npm

updateChannel.provisioning: The installed system needs the [linxira-zeta] section in /etc/pacman.conf. The current installer appends it (linxirapacstrap._enable_target_linxira_repo) and enables linxira-pacman-fetch; installs created before that change do not have it.

covers: linxira-zeta 1.5.0-1 (rebuilt from the published upstream 1.5.0 archive) -> published 1.5.1-1 in place
installed version equals the target package version
old zetawork file set removed; new /opt layout present
bundled kernel starts and reports the target version
linxira-zetawork replaced through the published Replaces/Conflicts
notCovered: Electron window start under a display server (the bundled kernel is what the script executes)

claims.statement: v1.5.1 is a published, non-prerelease GitHub release with linux tar.gz, deb, AppImage and win assets.
claims.evidence: gh api releases/tags/v1.5.1: published_at 2026-11-10T13:10:33Z, 18 assets after package-linkage.json upload; SHA256SUMS.txt hashes recorded in release.verifiedRelease.

claims.statement: linxira-zeta 1.5.1-1 is published in the [linxira-zeta] rolling repository with Replaces/Conflicts linxira-zetawork.
claims.evidence: linxira-zeta.db.tar.zst (zeta-repo updated 2026-11-10T13:18:15Z): linxira-zeta 1.5.1-1, csize 354210921, sha256 d173cda5..., Replaces/Conflicts linxira-zetawork; linxira-zeta-c-bin and linxira-zeta-ide 1.5.1-1. The 1.5.0 assets are no longer published.

claims.statement: The zetawork-era desktop was the same pacman package name (linxira-zeta, 1.4.10-1) that Provides zetawork/linxira-zeta; a separate linxira-zetawork 1.4.1-1 package existed earlier.
claims.evidence: .PKGINFO of the published linxira-zeta-1.4.10-1 package; installed pacman DB /var/lib/pacman/local/linxira-zeta-1.4.4-1 (desc/files) on a real Linxira OS install; retired PKGBUILD for linxira-zetawork.

claims.statement: linxira-zeta 1.5.x no longer Provides zetawork and installs /opt/linxira-zeta + /usr/bin/zeta-desktop instead of /usr/bin/zetawork.
claims.evidence: Current PKGBUILD package() and the published repo DB entry (no %PROVIDES%).

claims.statement: An existing linxira-zeta 1.4.x/1.5.0 install upgrades in place to 1.5.1 via pacman without uninstall.
claims.evidence: 2026-11-10, Linxira OS (Arch) pacman in disposable roots: published 1.4.10-1 -> published 1.5.0-1, then published 1.5.1-1 (sha256 d173cda5...) over a 1.5.0-1 package rebuilt from the published upstream 1.5.0 archive (the rolling cleanup removed the published 1.5.0-1). Final version 1.5.1-1; /usr/bin/zetawork and /usr/lib/zetawork gone; /opt/linxira-zeta + /usr/bin/zeta-desktop present; bundled kernel printed zetacode/1.5.1; ~/.zeta byte-identical. Reproduce with scripts/packaging/verify-linux-upgrade.sh.

claims.statement: pacman applies the published Replaces/Conflicts and removes linxira-zetawork when upgrading.
claims.evidence: 2026-11-10: synthetic linxira-zetawork 1.4.1-1 -> pacman -Su with the published 1.5.1-1 package in a file:// repo; the old package and /usr/bin/zetawork were removed and linxira-zeta 1.5.1-1 installed.

claims.statement: The deb is Package: zeta-desktop, Version 1.5.0, with no Conflicts/Replaces fields.
zeta-desktop is not published to npm; @linxiraos/main is frozen at 1.4.10.
claims.evidence: registry.npmjs.org: zeta-desktop -> Not found; @linxiraos/main dist-tags.latest 1.4.10; desktop/package.json private=true.

claims.statement: Every existing 1.4.x install can discover 1.5.x with pacman -Syu.
claims.evidence: BLOCKED for pre-2026-10-28 installs: the inspected Linxira OS image (linxira-zeta 1.4.4-1, installed 2026-10-27) has only the [linxira] section in /etc/pacman.conf and no XferCommand; linxira-zeta is absent from that repository. The [linxira-zeta] section is appended only by the newer installer code.

claims.statement: The v1.5.1 tag exists on the product repository.
claims.evidence: gh api git/ref/tags/v1.5.1 -> commit 54b0ffeb6588f95c0e3ceccc645a1d22c30daf48 (the main 1.5.1 bump commit).

claims.statement: A v1.5.1 GitHub release, desktop assets and a [linxira-zeta] 1.5.1 package exist.
claims.evidence: Release published 2026-11-10T13:10:33Z with zeta-desktop-1.5.1 linux tar.gz/deb/AppImage and win exe/zip; package-linkage.json attached (sha256 ef9f8f61..., before this update). [linxira-zeta] zeta-repo updated 2026-11-10T13:18:15Z with linxira-zeta/c-bin/ide 1.5.1-1.

claims.statement: A dpkg/apt upgrade from an earlier zeta-desktop deb to 1.5.1 preserves the install.
claims.evidence: Not exercised. Only the control identity of the 1.5.0 deb was inspected; the 1.5.1 deb transaction is untested.

claims.statement: Replacing an older AppImage with zeta-desktop-1.5.1-linux-x86_64.AppImage starts correctly.
claims.evidence: Not exercised: AppImage replacement is an unmanaged file swap with no pacman/dpkg transaction to assert.

claims.statement: Uninstalling the zetawork installer and installing zeta-desktop-1.5.1-win-x64.exe preserves user data.
claims.evidence: Not exercised. The installers have different identities (HKCU\Software\LinxiraZeta vs appId com.zeta.desktop), so this is a replace path, never an in-place upgrade.
